aiSummary: In October 2026, Windows led operating systems (combined) (desktop) in United Kingdom at 69.54% (market share of tracked page views / usage). OS X ranked second at 16.97%, followed by macOS at 7.13%.

faqs.question: Which item leads operating systems (combined) (desktop) in United Kingdom?
faqs.answer: Windows leads at 69.54% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/os-market-share/desktop/united-kingdom.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for operating systems (combined) (desktop) in United Kingdom?
faqs.answer: Windows (69.54%), OS X (16.97%), macOS (7.13%) in October 2026.
